review_notes: I read the whole file. It contains almost only lemmas. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication and proof shortening, so I did not report lemma-level overlaps such as the radial and ray lemmas about OpenPartialHomeomorph, or positive_countable_selection. The only new definitions are `CommonChoice` and `CommonChoice.time`. `CommonChoice` is a subtype of window triples with ordering constraints, and its Countable instance is derived. `CommonChoice.time` is a `![...]` vector of three times. These are specific to this development and I found no Mathlib structure with the same meaning. I did not check the declarations imported from the OAI project, such as Window, Subwindows, RadialCompare and Directions.allowed, because they are defined outside this file. I found no avoidable competing version of a Mathlib concept.
